# DATABASE SPEC

<!-- Generated by sdk-web <specPhase> on 2026-11-02; updated 2026-11-02 for hard-coded v1 -->

## v1: no database
Content is hard-coded. The "tables" below are TypeScript types in /lib/types.ts, with data in /content/*.ts.

StudioInfo
  name string            -- "AB Recording Studio"
  tagline string
  email string           -- "binauanders@gmail.com"
  address string?
  socials { instagram?, youtube?, spotify?, facebook? }

Musician
  slug string (unique)
  name string
  genre string?
  shortBio string
  bio string
  image string           -- /images/musicians/<slug>.jpg
  links { website?, spotify?, instagram?, youtube? }
  featured boolean
  credits MusicianCredit[]

MusicianCredit
  title string
  year number?
  workType "recording" | "mixing" | "mastering" | "production"
  link string?

AboutSection
  id string
  title string
  body string            -- markdown
  image string?

Festival
  name string
  tagline string?
  description string
  startDate string (ISO date)
  endDate string?
  venueName string
  venueAddress string?
  admission "free"
  rsvpNote string?       -- e.g. "No ticket needed, just show up"
  heroImage string?
  lineup LineupSlot[]

LineupSlot
  artistName string
  musicianSlug string?   -- links to a Musician profile when they're a studio artist
  stage string?
  performanceAt string?  -- ISO datetime
  order number

---

## Future (Supabase, not built in v1)
Planned schema for when an admin area is added. Content tables are owned by the studio (admins), not by individual users, so they use created_by for audit instead of user_id ownership.

Table: profiles
  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade
  display_name text
  role text not null default 'user' check (role in ('user','admin'))
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()

Table: musicians
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()
  name text not null
  slug text not null unique
  genre text
  short_bio text
  bio text
  image_url text
  website_url text
  spotify_url text
  instagram_url text
  youtube_url text
  featured boolean not null default false
  sort_order int not null default 0
  published boolean not null default false
  created_by uuid references auth.users(id)
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()

Table: musician_credits
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()
  musician_id uuid not null references musicians(id) on delete cascade
  title text not null              -- album, EP or single name
  release_year int
  work_type text                   -- recording, mixing, mastering, production
  link_url text
  sort_order int not null default 0
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
  index on musician_id

Table: about_sections
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()
  title text not null
  body text not null               -- markdown
  image_url text
  sort_order int not null default 0
  published boolean not null default false
  created_by uuid references auth.users(id)
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()

Table: festivals
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()
  name text not null
  slug text not null unique
  tagline text
  description text
  start_date date not null
  end_date date
  venue_name text
  venue_address text
  ticket_url text
  hero_image_url text
  is_current boolean not null default false   -- only one row true (partial unique index)
  published boolean not null default false
  created_by uuid references auth.users(id)
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()

Table: festival_lineup
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()
  festival_id uuid not null references festivals(id) on delete cascade
  musician_id uuid references musicians(id) on delete set null   -- links to a studio musician when there is one
  artist_name text not null
  stage text
  performance_at timestamptz
  sort_order int not null default 0
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
  index on festival_id, index on musician_id

Table: contact_messages
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()
  name text not null
  email text not null
  subject text                     -- booking, festival, general
  message text not null
  handled boolean not null default false
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()

Functions:
  is_admin() returns boolean, SECURITY DEFINER, checks profiles.role = 'admin' for auth.uid()
  handle_new_user() trigger creates a profiles row on auth.users insert
  set_updated_at() trigger on musicians, about_sections, festivals
